name: Alpine Valleys

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the North East Victoria zone, one of its five named wine regions. Chardonnay makes up 20 percent of plantings, Pinot Noir 16, Pinot Gris and Sauvignon Blanc 14 each, and Glera 11.
